My love, Sakina

Happy Birthday, meri jaan.

I wish I could put into words how much happiness you bring into my life. From the very first time I met you, you became someone truly special to me. Every memory we make has a place in my heart, and I look forward to all the beautiful moments still waiting for us.

May Allah bless you with happiness, good health, peace, success and everything your heart wishes for. May your smile never fade, and may I always be one of the reasons behind it.

I may not be perfect, but I promise to keep choosing you, respecting you, and finding new ways to make you feel loved.

Happy Birthday, my Chidkuu. I love you so much.

Forever yours,Adnan

Here's to you, to us, and to a lifetime of little moments. Now press the heart, as many times as you like.
